main.description: Replace a space's policy object wholesale. A policy with the same $type is a configuration change; a different $type migrates the space to a new policy and discards the previous policy's state (such as a memberspace member list). The updated policy is surfaced through com.atproto.space.getSpace. Requires auth with a covering manage=update grant, implemented by PDS.

space.description: Permissioned space URI, in the form at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Not a standard at-uri.

policy.description: The space's new policy object. Open union; policies other than the baseline set may be supported by a PDS.
